changes.comment: BREAKING: ITaskWriteGuard.guard now answers PromiseLike<Result<T>>, so AsyncControl.WriteGate from @fgv/ts-extras fits TaskBroker.create({ writeGuard }) as is. Every existing gate still fits. When the guard did not run the section, its failure is kept only if the failure's detail converts as an ITaskFailure; otherwise the result is storage-unavailable with retry after-host-action. A guard that answers success without running the section is invalid. TaskScheduleTimer is removed: TaskBroker.create({ schedule }) takes AsyncControl.ScheduleTimer, which is structurally identical.
